sections.heading: Data and AI delivery, owned end to end.

We work directly with organizations and as a delivery partner to consulting firms, and we stay accountable until the work holds up in production.

items.text: You need advice, specialist skills, a platform built or modernized, or more hands on a project that’s already underway. We can lead the work or join your team.

title: About
heading: Experienced people, working as one team.
lede: Aikyanix Core was formed by data professionals who had spent years delivering analytics, data engineering and platform work in enterprise environments. They wanted to do that work closer to the client, with clear ownership and no layers between the people asking the questions and the people building the answers.
seoDescription: Meet the team behind Aikyanix Core: experienced data and AI professionals working as one team, with clear ownership and direct communication.

children.text: Across our careers we saw what makes data projects succeed. It’s rarely the tool. It’s people who understand both the business question and the technical detail, who raise problems early, and who stay with the work until it’s dependable. We built a company around those habits, so clients and partners get them by default rather than by luck.

Aikyanix comes from aikya, a Sanskrit word meaning oneness, unity and harmony. It describes us in two ways. Inside the company, it is people with different specialties working as one team. In our work, it is the job itself: bringing disconnected systems, data and teams together into something the business can rely on.

Our people have built their experience in data warehousing, SAP data and analytics, cloud data platforms, data integration, enterprise reporting and planning, and machine learning. They gained it in earlier roles with consulting firms, enterprises and delivery teams, before Aikyanix Core was formed. We bring that judgment to every engagement, along with a steady investment in learning newer platforms and AI tools as they mature.
